Properties.Name: RenderRaceStints
Properties.Description: Show the tyre stint chart in race results.

Properties.Name: RenderQualiStints
Properties.Description: Show the tyre stint chart in qualifying and combined qualifying results.

Properties.Name: RenderPointsOnRaceLayout
Properties.Description: Show the points column in race results.

Properties.Name: RenderTeamBadgesOnSessionResults
Properties.PublicName: Render Team Badges on Session Results
Properties.Description: Show team logos in race and qualifying results.

Properties.Name: Commentator
Properties.Description: Name shown on the commentator sticker in race results. Leave empty to hide the sticker.

Properties.Name: ShowPenaltyPointsInStandings
Properties.Description: Show the penalty points column in driver standings.

Properties.Name: DNSReplacementForSeasonProgress
Properties.Description: Text shown instead of a position when a driver did not start a round (season progress by positions). Leave empty for a blank cell.

Properties.Name: ShowWinnerInCalendar
Properties.Description: Show the winner of each completed round in the calendar.

Properties.Name: SecondCalendarEventsInColumn
Properties.Description: How many rounds go into the first column of the two-column calendar; the rest fill the second column. Affects the Calendar V2 layout only.

Properties.Name: ReserveDriverMax
Properties.Description: Currently unused - the only layout that read it (QRL Joker Lineup) is disabled and moved to _disabled/. Kept so the setting survives if that layout comes back.

Properties.Name: RenderDriverFlags
Properties.Description: Show the driver's national flag next to their name, in results and lineups.

Properties.Name: RenderTeamBadgesOnOtherLayouts
Properties.PublicName: Render Team Badges on Other Layouts
Properties.Description: Show team logos outside session results - lineups, team standings and team season progress.
